items.title: Yemen’s Houthis launch ballistic missile attacks on al-Makha and Marib

items.title: Middle East: Trump took secret flight out of Turkey over Iran threat
items.summary: President Donald Trump reportedly used an elaborate ruse to leave the NATO summit in Turkey, amid a credible assassination threat. Meanwhile, oil prices rose as hopes for a deal on the Strait of Hormuz fade. DW has more.
